ENGINEERING FOR REAL USE

Functionality that goes beyond the interface.

Depending on the approved requirements, a custom application may include account management, role-based permissions, databases, dashboards, integrations and cloud deployment.

  1. Structured user journeys and interface design.

  2. User authentication and access levels.

  3. Database-backed functionality.

  4. APIs and third-party integrations where feasible.

  5. Payment and subscription integration where required.

  6. Testing, deployment and agreed post-launch support.
